senses.gloss: m. (v. גָּרָה Hithpa.) heat, jealousy, partiality; קרא ת׳ [to cry out, ‘it is partiality’,] to reproach, complain of injustice.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 5:3:2">Y. Ber. V, 9ᶜ</cite> top; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Megillah 4:10:3">Y. Meg. IV, 75ᶜ</cite> top <he>כקורא תי׳ על מידותיו וכ׳</he> it is as if he reflected on God’s dealings, (saying,) over the bird’s nest thy mercies extend, but over this man (myself) they do not extend; (<cite ref="Berakhot 33b">Ber. 33ᵇ</cite> <he>מטיל קנאה וכ׳</he> he throws jealousy among God’s creatures).

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 40:2">Gen. R. s. 40</cite> <he>לא קרא ת׳ ולא הקפיד</he> he did not reproach (God), nor did he lose his temper; <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 40:2">ib.</cite> s. 92. Ib. s. 17 <he>צפה</he> … <he>לקרות עליה ת׳ וכ׳</he> God foresaw that he (Adam) would reproach (God) on her account (<cite ref="Genesis 3:12">Gen. III, 12</cite>), therefore he did not create her until he (Adam) asked for her; a. e.
